Indie dev and solo-founder tools

Question. Which jobs of indie developers, solo founders and micro-SaaS teams (1-5 people) are under-served by current developer and founder software and workarounds, and which could a small SaaS, built mostly by an AI coding agent and run with about 5 human hours a week and a budget under $300, serve profitably (>= $1,000 MRR) with growth built into the product?

Options generated
51
Tested with evidence
8
Promising
1
Verified quotes
289
Products mapped
395
Subagents used
91

Best options

  • #1 OPP-048: Unmet: Faster outage detection (unmet need (gap)). Evidence: promising, 4 supporting records from 3 authors on 3 websites.
  • #2 OPP-032: Cheaper alternative to Tidio, Zoho SalesIQ - Live Chat App (Live chat and help desk) (proven product + one improvement). Evidence: thin, 4 supporting records from 4 authors on 1 website. 100 paying customers at $10/month reach $1k/month.
  • #3 OPP-033: More reliable alternative to Tidio, Zoho SalesIQ - Live Chat App (Live chat and help desk) (proven product + one improvement). Evidence: thin, 3 supporting records from 3 authors on 1 website. 100 paying customers at $10/month reach $1k/month.
  • #4 OPP-012: Migration target for Lemon Squeezy users (replacement after a shutdown, price rise or platform change). Evidence: thin, 2 supporting records from 2 authors on 1 website. 71 paying customers at $14/month reach $1k/month.
  • #5 OPP-013: Migration target for TaxJar users (replacement after a shutdown, price rise or platform change). Evidence: thin, 2 supporting records from 2 authors on 2 websites. 26 paying customers at $39/month reach $1k/month.

Next step

  • Pick one and run the full method on it as a narrow question: `gapscan.py init gap-runs/opp-048-unmet-faster-outage-detection --from-run gap-runs/indie-dev-tools-replay --opportunity OPP-048`
  • Also drafted: OPP-032 (output/next-runs/OPP-032.protocol.json).

Caveats

  • A scan is a breadth sample: one landscape round, single screening, no codebook and no double coding. Treat each opportunity as a lead to test, not a finding.
  • Landscape search stopped before saturation (STOP_UNSATURATED): product counts are lower bounds.
  • Traction numbers exist for 151 of 335 products (marketplace listings only); products without them are never ranked as proven.
  • 211 coverage gaps logged (blocked or empty sources); see coverage-gaps.jsonl.
  • Landscape search: stopped before saturation.
